notes: Bigger UI pass: live header state, session chips, running-game dots
patch_notes: A deeper UI pass, at Ariya's request. A header band now shows the live state in words (waiting for sensors, idle, in session with the game named, running hot). The session card gains three chips - peak CPU, peak GPU, time over the line - colored by severity. Every watched game gets a running dot that lights green while it plays. The repaste verdict card's border takes the verdict's color. The live graph labels the current CPU and GPU values at its right edge. New test round 16 covers the header, chips, dots, labels and verdict border; all 16 rounds pass.
